Specification: This specification defines a very small state machine over a single variable x. Both the outer module and a nested module Base specify the same behavior: x starts at 0 and every step preserves x in Nat while incrementing it by 1. The spec verifies a temporal behavior using a boxed action formula with stuttering over x, and it includes an INSTANCE of the nested Base module without any substitutions.
